mechanism_and_quality_notes: Actual exported and committed 1200x630 RGB pixels inspected. Conversation, plan and code-change strands preserve the same worktree across editor handoff. Review precedes continued prompting/manual edits, local checks, final diff review and updating the same pull request. Neutral circles do not imply tests passed; blank change tiles are not fake code. No merge action, disconnected checkout, people, scenery, faux paragraphs or added punctuation. The bridge is an explicitly conceptual worktree-continuity metaphor.
alt: Conversation, plan and code changes cross a continuous same-worktree bridge into VS Code, followed by changed-file review, prompting or manual edits, local checks, final diff review and an update to the same pull request.
